Each output element is accumulated\n// over k = 0..N-1 in ascending order, matching the sequential reference.\n__global__ void matmulKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, const size_t M, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[BK][BM];\n    __shared__ double Bs[BK][BN];\n\n    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const unsigned tid = ty * BLOCK_DIM + tx;\n    constexpr unsigned NUM_THREADS = BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM;\n\n    const size_t rowBase = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BM;\n    const size_t colBase = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BN;\n\n    double acc[TM][TN] = {};\n\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < N; k0 += BK) {\n        const size_t kLen = min(static_cast<size_t>(BK), N - k0);\n\n        // Stage A tile (transposed into shared memory) with bounds checks.\n        for (unsigned idx = tid; idx < BM * BK; idx += NUM_THREADS) {\n            const unsigned r = idx / BK;\n            const unsigned c = idx % BK;\n            const size_t gr = rowBase + r;\n            const size_t gc = k0 + c;\n            As[c][r] = (gr < M && c < kLen) ?                                    \\\n            exit(1);                                                              \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Output tile per thread block is BM x BN, computed by a BLOCK_DIM x BLOCK_DIM\n// thread block where each thread owns a TM x TN register sub-tile.\nconstexpr unsigned BLOCK_DIM = 16;\nconstexpr unsigned TM = 4;\nconstexpr unsigned TN = 4;\nconstexpr unsigned BM = BLOCK_DIM * TM;\nconstexpr unsigned BN = BLOCK_DIM * TN;\nconstexpr unsigned BK = 16;\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\nvoid initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes C = A * B for a block of `M` rows of A (row-major, M x N) against\n// the full B (N x N), producing C (M x N). Each output element is accumulated\n// over k = 0..N-1 in ascending order, matching the sequential reference.\n__global__ void matmulKernel(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                             double* __restrict__ C, const size_t M, const size_t N) {\n    __shared__ double As[BK][BM];\n    __shared__ double Bs[BK][BN];\n\n    const unsigned tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const unsigned ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const unsigned tid = ty * BLOCK_DIM + tx;\n    constexpr unsigned NUM_THREADS = BLOCK_DIM * BLOCK_DIM;\n\n    const size_t rowBase = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * BM;\n    const size_t colBase = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * BN;\n\n    double acc[TM][TN] = {};\n\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < N; k0 += BK) {\n        const size_t kLen = min(static_cast<size_t>(BK), N - k0);\n\n        // Stage A tile (transposed into shared memory) with bounds checks.\n        for (unsigned idx = tid; idx < BM * BK; idx += NUM_THREADS) {\n            const unsigned r = idx / BK;\n            const unsigned c = idx % BK;\n            const size_t gr = rowBase + r;\n            const size_t gc = k0 + c;\n            As[c][r] = (gr < M && c < kLen) ? A[gr * N + gc] : 0.0;\n        }\n        // Stage B tile with bounds checks.\n        for (unsigned idx = tid; idx < BK * BN; idx += NUM_THREADS) {\n            const unsigned r = idx / BN;\n            const unsigned c = idx % BN;\n            const size_t gr = k0 + r;\n            const size_t gc = colBase + c;\n            Bs[r][c] = (r < kLen && gc < N) ? B[gr * N + gc] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (unsigned kk = 0; kk < kLen; ++kk) {\n            double a[TM];\n            double b[TN];\n            for (unsigned m = 0; m < TM; ++m) a[m] = As[kk][ty * TM + m];\n            for (unsigned n = 0; n < TN; ++n) b[n] = Bs[kk][tx * TN + n];\n            for (unsigned m = 0; m < TM; ++m)\n                for (unsigned n = 0; n < TN; ++n)\n                    acc[m][n] += a[m] * b[n];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (unsigned m = 0; m < TM; ++m) {\n        const size_t r = rowBase + ty * TM + m;\n        if (r >= M) continue;\n        for (unsigned n = 0; n < TN; ++n) {\n            const size_t c = colBase + tx * TN + n;\n            if (c < N) C[r * N + c] = acc[m][n];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nint getDeviceCount() {\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA-capable device found\\n\");\n        exit(1);\n    }\n    return deviceCount;\n}\n\n// One-time CUDA runtime and per-GPU context creation. Called before timing so\n// the benchmark measures computation rather than driver startup.\nvoid initCuda() {\n    const int deviceCount = getDeviceCount();\n    for (int d = 0; d < deviceCount; ++d) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(d));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));\n    }\n}\n\n// Splits the rows of C across all visible GPUs; each GPU receives its row\n// block of A and a full copy of B, and the device work runs concurrently.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    if (N == 0) return;\n\n    const size_t numParts = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(getDeviceCount()), N);\n    const size_t rowsPerPart = N / numParts;\n    const size_t extraRows = N % numParts;\n\n    std::vector<std::thread> workers;\n    workers.reserve(numParts);\n    size_t row0 = 0;\n    for (size_t d = 0; d < numParts; ++d) {\n        const size_t rows = rowsPerPart + (d < extraRows ? 1 : 0);\n        workers.emplace_back([&A, &B, &C, N, d, row0, rows]() {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(static_cast<int>(d)));\n\n            double *dA = nullptr, *dB = nullptr, *dC = nullptr;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dA, rows * N * sizeof(double)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dB, N * N * sizeof(double)));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dC, rows * N * sizeof(double)));\n\n            cudaStream_t stream;","numLines":150,"startLine":1,"totalLines":292}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01QYsPGH2hF279HYTETowzEu","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxPX8sk6m6RptLgE1S2S","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The matmul benchmark now runs on CUDA and spreads the rows of C across every visible GPU. It builds cleanly into the same `matmul` executable, and its output matches a CPU build with the same floating-point semantics bit-for-bit at every size I tested.\n\n**What changed** (only `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt`; no new files)\n- **Kernel:** a 64×64 output tile per block, with 16×16 threads each owning a 4×4 register sub-tile and 16-wide shared-memory K tiles. Bounds checks cover arbitrary N.\n- **Multi-GPU:** rows of C are split across all GPUs. Each GPU gets its A block and a full copy of B, runs in its own host thread, and copies its C block back.\n- **Semantics:** each C element is still summed over k = 0..N-1 in ascending order, starting from 0.0.\n- **Timing:** one-time CUDA startup (about 2.5 s here) is kept out of the timed region. Only the matmul is timed, as before.\n- **CMake:** `matmul.cpp` is compiled as CUDA, `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` is `native`, and the minimum CMake version is now 3.24.\n\n**Decisions you may want to revisit**\n- **`-fmad=false`:** disables FMA contraction, so `sum += a*b` rounds twice, as the source literally says. This matched the original's `-r` hashes on 29 of 49 sizes, against 12 with FMA. The cost is about 25–35% at large N (N=4096: 311 ms without FMA, 230 ms with). Removing the flag gives the faster build.\n- **Host-side init and validation** stay on the CPU, as before. Only the matmul moved to the GPU.\n\n**Verification** (4× RTX 3090 here)\n- Output is bit-identical to the original source built with `-ffp-contract=off`, for every size I checked. Validation passes.\n- Against the original binary, hashes match for all even N tested. They differ for odd N because GCC fuses the final odd-length remainder term into an FMA. That is a one-ULP difference, not a bug.\n- Timing: N=1024 went from 7.8 s on the original to about 40 ms (FMA build; I didn't time the no-FMA build at this size). With no-FMA, N=2048 takes 84 ms and N=4096 takes 311 ms.\n- Only tested on four GPUs. The single-GPU path is the same code with one part, but I did not run it.\n- Build and test artifacts are in `/tmp`, not in the repo."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1130,"cache_read_input_tokens":60692,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1130},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8339413a-628e-41d0-b215-a828cf889054","uuid":"c3e58174-5c36-4857-bab3-dc82781a2e1c","timestamp":"2026-10-12T13:03:33.960Z","request_id":"req_011CfxPX8ZPuC27iuU17o4E5"}
